privacy.controllerBody: {brand} SaaS Platform, in compliance with GDPR and applicable national laws, prioritizes the security and privacy of all user data.
privacy.dataBody: Account registration, session authentication, EU funding call matching, AI-assisted concept note drafting, and subscription billing processes involve processing names, emails, organization profiles, and payment metadata.
privacy.rightsBody: Under GDPR and applicable data protection law, you can export your data as JSON at any time from “Settings → Privacy & My Data”. From the same screen you can request deletion of your account: it is closed immediately and all of your data and uploaded files are permanently deleted after 30 days. You may cancel the request within that 30-day window. For security, authentication secrets (OAuth and session tokens) are excluded from the export file.

settings.identityMissingWarning: No billing identity is on file for this organisation. Until these details are entered, no invoice can be issued for payments already taken.
settings.identityVknHint: 10 digits (VKN) for a company, 11 digits (TCKN) for a sole trader.
settings.identityMaskedHint: Only the last 4 digits are shown.
settings.identityPrivacyNote: This number is used only to issue invoices; it is never shown or logged in full.
settings.identitySaved: Billing identity saved. Invoices can be issued for payments from now on.
settings.identitySavedNotChargeable: Billing identity saved. Invoicing for {country} is still on hold: its VAT treatment has not been decided and needs a tax adviser's ruling.
settings.identityCountryPendingHint: The VAT treatment for the country you picked has not been decided yet. Your details are saved, but issuing an invoice depends on that ruling.
settings.identityErrValidation: Nothing was saved. Correct the marked fields and try again.
settings.identityErrLength: A VKN is 10 digits and a TCKN is 11.
settings.identityErrChecksum: That is not a valid VKN/TCKN. Please check it.
settings.identityErrCountry: There is no sourced VAT rate for this country, so it cannot be invoiced.
settings.identityErrForbidden: You do not have permission to change these details.
settings.identityErrWrite: The details could not be saved. Please try again shortly.

adminPlans.title: Plan Management

adminPlans.immutableHint: A published version cannot be edited. Editing creates a new draft version.

editor.title: Draft version v{version}
editor.hint: This draft affects no tenant until it is published. A published version can never be edited again.
editor.featureGrantHint: A module bullet may only name a module this version grants; anything outside the grant is refused.

impact.mustCheck: Press "Compute impact" before publishing: publishing is not offered until you have been shown how many live tenants lose limits.
impact.lowers: This change lowers limits for {count} live tenant(s).
impact.loweredNoTenants: This version lowers limits, but no tenant is on this plan right now — nobody is affected.
impact.none: This change lowers no tenant's limits ({count} live tenants).

assign.title: Assign tenants to a private plan
assign.hint: A private plan is unlisted; only assigned tenants can see it.

errors.PUBLISHED_VERSION_IMMUTABLE: A published version cannot be changed. Create a new draft first.
errors.IMPACT_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED: Publish refused: the affected-tenant count moved. Recompute the impact.
errors.MODULE_NOT_GRANTED: A card bullet names a module this plan does not grant.
errors.PLAN_IN_USE: A plan with live subscriptions cannot be deleted — archive it.
errors.PLATFORM_ADMIN_REQUIRED: This action requires a platform administrator.

approval.error: The approval step could not be completed.
